incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected for bergstone (dedicated-berg-5). 70% 502s across the inference fleet over the last 2m. Auto-throttle triggered. Paging oncall.
deploy-bot: Rollback attempt queued for pool dedicated-berg-5 to previous model hash sha256:ab12... — will run if errors persist for 3m.
jamal: Ack. I'm oncall. Pulling latest logs and checking NVMe + network metrics.
marta: Jamal — good call. Check KV cache hit rate and the model variant routing table. If KV miss rate > 40% then fallback to cached-prefix mode.
jamal: Quick checks:
- cpu/gpu utilisation normal
- NVMe IO spike ~ 120% on node berg-5b
- KV cache miss ~ 48% on tail traffic
Logs show repeated: `model_runner::kv_cache_miss` and `grpc: upstream closed` around the same time.
marta: Sounds like cache thrash + a node flapping. Proceed with one-by-one draining of the worst node and route traffic off it. If drains fail, trigger fallback-model routing.
jamal: Draining berg-5b now: `rdwctl node drain dedicated-berg-5b` — draining -> 80% successful connections rerouted.
incident-bot: Note: draining action taken by jamal at 1767777105.
jamal: After drain: 5xx rate dropped to 18% but still above SLO. Deploy-bot rollback pending — holding for 2m to observe.
emily-csm: Drafting a customer-facing note for Bergstone. Posting below for review — please keep it concise and avoid technical verbatim.
emily-csm: SUBJECT: Service disruption impacting inference for your dedicated cluster (bergstone)
BODY:
Hi Bergstone ops team —
We're investigating increased errors affecting inference requests for your dedicated pool. We've initiated traffic reroutes and are mitigating the root cause. You may see intermittent 502 responses. We're prioritizing stability and will provide updates every 30 minutes. If you'd like a dedicated bridge, I can open one now.
Apologies for the disruption — Emily, Customer Success
jamal: That reads well. Suggest adding: "No customer data was exposed; requests that succeeded are unaffected." Keep it high level.
marta: +1. Add estimated next update time: "next update ~ 30 minutes" and mention who to contact.
emily-csm: Updated body with both. Ready to send once we confirm customer-impact level.
jamal: At 1767777200: 5xx rate stable at 6% after completing drain + soft-rebalance. We'll keep the rollback on standby if rates climb.
marta: Good. Status page update (short): "Partial service disruption affecting dedicated inference in us-west-2 for specific customer pools. Mitigations in progress. Impact: intermittent 502s. Next update in 30m." Who will post?
alex: I'll publish the status page and send the Bergstone note. I'll also start a short bridge at #bergstone-bridge and invite their ops contact.
jamal: Handing off to alex at 1767777250 for monitoring window and customer comms. If 5xx > 10% for 5m, escalate to infra lead and execute rollback.
marta: Escalation path: alex -> oncall infra lead (marta) -> SRE director. Add runbook link: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/dedicated-fallback
alex: Got it. Posting status, sending customer note, creating bridge. I'll keep thread updated with any regression. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident thread created and assigned to jamal. Current severity: SEV3 (customer-impacting single-customer degradation).
